metric.definition: measurePageFill(sheet, planned): ink bbox of module frames (computeBlockFrames) + component positions + pin endpoints, over the delivered sheet (sheet.pageSize when fitted)
metric.rule: checkPageBudget(sheets, planned) -> {ok, pages, violations}; per page target/minimum/ceiling/floor, board-level distribution/pagination
metric.composability: page-budget.ts:82 fits the OUTWARD box (outwardContentBox(anchors)), not the ink box, which is the t11 defect fix. Independently confirmed: on every delivered page minSize equals the delivered size and atMinimum is true (1230x1170, 910x1170, 890x825).

adversarial.note: run by this review against the rebuilt bundle, not taken from the report

cases.detail: MAIN 1230x1170 fill 47.9% atMin=true; MAIN 2 910x1170 fill 40.0% atMin=true
5 pages 592x1170 at 23.7% each; floor (25%) and pagination both fire, so this bypass is closed
1655x1170 at 44.3% - legitimately above target, not a bypass

cases.case: control: tail shipped on the planned A3 instead of converging

adversarial.bypassConclusion: no bypass found: every below-target page is caught either by minimum (not delivered on its smallest sheet), ceiling (the shape could reach the target) or floor (below 25%)
adversarial.specEnforcement: page-budget.spec.ts asserts the rule verdict and the rule NAMES (rules(report) toEqual [] / [floor, minimum] / [ceiling, floor, minimum] / distribution / pagination), so the rule is executed in the gate; the parts==[18,12] assertion is a shape guard alongside the rule assertion, not the enforcement
